title: Collaboration as an approach to transforming conflict in community-based ecotourism management in state forest areas in West Java, Indonesia
core_idea: Explore collaboration as a process of conflict transformation among stakeholders in community-based ecotourism management of state forest areas, aiming to resolve disputes and achieve long-term change; investigated using qualitative methods (in-depth interviews, participant observation, and qualitative thematic analyses).
tldr: A qualitative study examining collaborative, multi-stakeholder approaches to transform conflicts in community-based ecotourism management of state forest areas to enable long-term resolution and change.
